svg.title: Tubes: every part facing the same way
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, seen from above, part of a tube of SOIC-8 chips, the tube shortened. Top: every chip has its pin-1 dot at the left. Bottom: a tube refilled by hand with some chips turned end for end, so their pin-1 dots are at the right; the assembler must empty and reload it.

g.text: Every part the same way round
The whole tube must be emptied and reloaded
Drawn to scale: SOIC-8, 4.9 × 3.9 mm, tube shortened.
A tube is symmetrical, so it can also be loaded into the feeder backwards.
